p2.goal: Protocol B pilot p2 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded). (a) Literature baselines not run before, paper settings, 3 seeds: DLO and ILO (Hu et al. 2022; top-3 lowest-entropy orders of the pre-trained model, lr 1e-4), MvP (Gou et al. 2023; top-5 orders by log-probability as prompted views, majority vote, lr 1e-4), Review Combination (Findings NAACL 2025; Algorithm 1, the combined set replaces train). (b) Self-training with a pseudo-label scorer (Zhang et al. ACL 2024) without external data: unlabelled texts = syn_infill texts whose source is in inner_train (data/aug/st_pool_inner.jsonl); comparison data = gold labels of inner_train vs beam candidates of 5 cross-validation models; scorer = ViT5-base, listwise + NLL; filters: confidence >= 0.7 then scorer band top 10-40 %; reranking of 4 beam candidates at inference. dv_st_conf = confidence filter only, same size (isolates the scorer filter); dv_none_rr = no augmentation + reranking (isolates reranking). Go rule written before results: dv_st reranked inner_dev F1 (5 seeds) >= dv_none + 2.0. Added after p2_s1/s2 (2026-11-02): dv_none_lr1e4 = no augmentation at lr 1e-4 (control for the lr of DLO/ILO/MvP). Re-run of the ST chain after two fixes: candidates OOM on long texts (st_pl_0/1 failed), and the comparison positive written in gold quad order while negatives were sorted (order shortcut; first scorer and dv_none_rr kept locally as outputs/*_shortcut). lr choice (written 2026-11-02, before any result at the new lrs): lr in {1e-4, 2e-4, 3e-4} with the highest mean inner_dev F1 of no augmentation over 5 seeds (dv_none_lr1e4, dv_none_lr2e4, dv_none); it fills vars.lr, and every run that waits for it is then trained at that lr (the ST chain, and ADA joint, concat, EDA, GenDA, infill_t, RC rebuilt from inner_train; DLO/ILO/MvP again only if the lr is not 1e-4; *_lrsel runs whose lr equals an existing run are dropped). Chosen after p2_s3: lr 1e-4 (no augmentation, 5 seeds: 1e-4 63.94, 2e-4 62.46, 3e-4 61.35); DLO/ILO/MvP already at 1e-4. After p2_s4/s5: the confidence filter was broken (finished beams are filled with EOS, and EOS after EOS counted in the min token probability) -> 29 of 12,217 pseudo-labels kept, so dv_st / dv_st_conf were in effect no augmentation (moved locally to outputs/*_confbug); fixed and the ST arm re-run (teacher, scorer, select, dv_st, dv_st_conf); dv_none_rr and the baselines are unaffected. Go rule (unchanged threshold, same lr on both sides): dv_st reranked mean of 5 seeds >= no augmentation at the chosen lr + 2.0.
p2.status: done 2026-11-03 (p2_s1-s6, 68 jobs). lr 1e-4 chosen; at 1e-4 no augmentation 63.94 (5 seeds); no data augmentation helps (ADA joint, concat, EDA, GenDA, infill_t, RC within -2.1..+0.1); ST no go: dv_st reranked 62.79, greedy 63.87 vs 65.94 required; MvP 65.49 (3 seeds)

p3.goal: Protocol B pilot p3 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded), every run at lr 1e-4 (fixed after p2). Multi-view consensus distillation (MVD): an MvP teacher (dv_mvp seed 7, trained on inner_train, checkpoint kept) labels the 12,217 synthetic texts of data/aug/st_pool_inner.jsonl with its 5 views (greedy); pseudo-label = majority-vote quads (explicit spans grounded in the text). dv_mvd: only reviews where no quad gets a minority vote (views agree), 2,015 drawn at random (= size of dv_st_conf); dv_mvd_all: the same without the agreement filter. Students: single-view Paraphrase on inner_train + the set. Also dv_mvp seeds 7 and 99 (MvP to 5 seeds, same configuration as p2). Written 2026-11-03 before any p3 result. Go rule: dv_mvd greedy inner_dev F1, mean of 5 seeds >= no augmentation at 1e-4 (dv_none_lr1e4, 63.94) + 2.0 = 65.94. Secondary (reported, not for the decision): dv_mvd vs dv_st_conf (single-view teacher, same pool and size: isolates the multi-view teacher); dv_mvd vs dv_mvd_all (agreement filter); implicit-type slices; MvP 5 seeds vs no augmentation. Student + MvP vote vs MvP only if the go rule passes (a later session).
p3.status: done 2026-11-03 (p3_s1, 13 jobs). No go: dv_mvd greedy 63.78 vs 65.94 required; dv_mvd_all 64.17; MvP 5 seeds 65.23

p4.goal: Protocol B pilot p4 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded), lr 1e-4. Ensemble distillation (ENS): five no-augmentation models (dv_ens_teacher, seeds 42 123 2024 7 99, same configuration as dv_none_lr1e4, checkpoints kept) each label the 12,217 synthetic texts of data/aug/st_pool_inner.jsonl (greedy); pseudo-label = quads predicted by >= 3 of the 5 teachers (explicit spans grounded in the text). Motivation (written 2026-11-03 from existing predictions): the majority vote of the five dv_none_lr1e4 models scores 68.90 on inner_dev vs 63.94 for one model (+5.0), while the MvP teacher of p3 was only ~+1.5 above its student. dv_ens: 2,015 reviews drawn at random (= dv_st_conf, dv_mvd_all), no agreement filter; dv_ens_2x: 4,030. Students: single-view Paraphrase on inner_train + the set. Written 2026-11-03 before any p4 result. Go rule: dv_ens greedy inner_dev F1, mean of 5 seeds >= 63.94 + 2.0 = 65.94. Secondary (reported, not for the decision): teacher strength at the same pool and size (dv_st_conf single model, dv_mvd_all MvP, dv_ens 5-model ensemble); dv_ens_2x vs dv_ens (size); implicit-type slices; inner_dev F1 of the new teachers (5 more no-augmentation runs) and of their ensemble (a second ensemble sample next to 68.90).

p5.goal: Protocol B pilot p5 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded), lr 1e-4. Written 2026-11-03 before any p5 result, after the second literature survey. (1) Text-position tuple order: the target lists the quads in the order they start in the review (--tuple_order text) instead of the annotation order (70 % of inner_train reviews differ; for reviews with >= 4 gold quads the recall of no augmentation falls 0.63 / 0.60 / 0.44 over the annotation-order thirds). dv_pos: 10 seeds (42 123 2024 7 99 11 13 17 19 23); dv_none_lr1e4 gets seeds 11 13 17 19 23 (same configuration) so both arms have 10 seeds (minimum detectable effect ~1.9 F1 at 80 % power with std 1.45, vs ~2.9 with 5). (2) Weight averaging of seed checkpoints (src/soup.py): uniform soup and greedy soup (ingredients added only if official-dev F1 does not drop; inner_dev not used to choose) of dv_pos seeds A = 42..99, dv_pos seeds B = 11..23, and dv_none_lr1e4 seeds B. Go rule (1): dv_pos mean of 10 seeds >= dv_none_lr1e4 mean of the same 10 seeds + 2.0. (2) is exploratory (one soup per group): reported against the mean of its 5 ingredients and against their majority-vote ensemble; promising if both dv_pos uniform soups are >= their ingredient mean + 2.0. Secondary: Welch dv_pos vs dv_none; recall by number of gold quads and by position third; implicit types. If p4 (ensemble distillation) fails, its re-run with text-order labels and the full pool is planned after p4 is in.

cf.goal: CONFIRMATORY STUDY (protocol B), pre-registered 2026-11-06 before any run; user decisions 2026-11-06: M1 5 seeds, all six literature baselines, soup as an analysis only. Full train (2,135) -> checkpoints on official dev (221) -> official test (583) decoded once per run at its end; no test score is read (no F1 printed, audit = rows/ids only) until every run of the round is in. lr 1e-4 for every method. M0 cf_none: plain ViT5 Paraphrase, 10 seeds (A+B); seeds A keep checkpoints = the 5 teachers. Teachers greedy-label the full-train pool data/aug/st_pool_train.jsonl (15,907 texts; all sources in train; leakage check 2026-11-06: 0 exact matches with dev/test, max bigram Jaccard 0.23/0.25) -> cf_select: majority >= 3/5 + grounded spans, all kept (--n 20000) -> data/aug/cf_ens_full.jsonl; teacher checkpoints deleted. M1 cf_ens_full_pos (main, recipe fixed by pilot p6): train + cf_ens_full, --tuple_order text, seeds A. M2 cf_pos (text order only): 10 seeds. Literature DA baselines (5 seeds A, the full-train sets of the exploratory phase): ADA joint, concat (batch 8 x grad_accum 2), EDA, GenDA, RC (train replaced by the recombined set), MvP (order scores on full train, top-5 views). Hypotheses (Holm over 2, two-sided Welch t-test on per-seed test quad F1, alpha 0.05): H1 M1 > M0; H2 M1 > M2. Secondary, reported without correction: M1 vs each literature baseline; uniform + greedy soup of M1 seeds 2024/7/99 vs the mean of its ingredients (analysis, not a table row); 5-teacher majority-vote ensemble on test (from the M0 seeds A test predictions, CPU; reference at 5x inference cost); P/R; implicit types; slices. p7 ablations are reported from the pilot (inner_dev); ADDED 2026-11-06 before any test or dev score of the round was read: two ablations on test, a separate secondary family (Holm over 2, Welch vs M1): A1 cf_single_full_pos = train + the pool labelled by teacher seed 42 alone (the first seed, same rule as the pilot; data/aug/cf_single_full.jsonl, 15,906 texts, 48,726 quads, implicit 13.3 %), text order, 5 seeds; A2 cf_ens_full = M1 data with the default order, 3 seeds (42 123 2024). Packing: M1 seeds 42/123 run in the session of the teacher chain; seeds 2024/7/99 (checkpoints kept) and their soup are held (var ens_set) until cf_ens_full.jsonl is ingested and pushed, then ens_set = data/aug/cf_ens_full.jsonl.

ac.goal: ACOS CONFIRMATORY STUDY (English; Cai et al. 2021 Restaurant-ACOS and Laptop-ACOS, released splits unchanged, data/acos/{rest,laptop}), pre-registered 2026-11-11 before any run. Transfer test: the method and every hyperparameter are fixed from the Vi-AbSQA study (round cf); nothing is tuned on ACOS. Only language-specific parts change: backbone t5-base (the English backbone of Paraphrase, Zhang et al. 2021) instead of ViT5-base; English label words (category in lower case with # and _ as spaces, e.g. 'laptop operation performance'; polarity positive/negative/neutral; label inventory = the categories of train+dev+test, Rest 13, Laptop 121); pool generated with the English infilling prompt (synth_reviews.py --lang en; Rest 11,511, Laptop 21,095 unlabelled texts after the source filter). Per dataset: M0 ac_<d>_none plain Paraphrase, gold order, lr 1e-4, 10 seeds (A keep checkpoints = the 5 teachers, B); teachers greedy-label the pool -> ac_<d>_select: quads with >= 3 of 5 votes and grounded explicit spans, all kept -> data/aug/ac_<d>_ens.jsonl, teacher checkpoints deleted; M1 ac_<d>_ens_pos = train + voted pool, --tuple_order text, seeds A; M2 ac_<d>_pos = text order only, 10 seeds. Checkpoints on the released dev, test decoded once per run at its end; no test score is read (audit = rows/ids/configs only) until every job of the round is in. Hypotheses per dataset (two-sided Welch t-test on per-seed test quad F1, alpha 0.05, Holm over the 2 within each dataset, as in cf): H1 M1 > M0; H2 M1 > M2. Secondary (no correction): P/R, implicit types, 5-teacher vote ensemble on test (CPU, from M0 seeds A predictions). Published ACOS numbers (Paraphrase, MvP, INLG 2025 ...) are cited as context only, not tested. Packing: chains (teachers -> labels -> select) in the first session; M1 students held (vars rest_ens, laptop_ens) until the voted sets are ingested and pushed.
